$note: Logic-pattern taxonomy. Every exercise carries exactly one primary pattern. Closing a CLO requires passing three exercises with three DIFFERENT patterns in a row. The Author agent must never generate a variant with the same pattern as the exercise it is varying unless the request says so.

patterns.name: Accumulate
patterns.description: Build a running total, count, product or string across a loop.

patterns.name: Filter
patterns.description: Keep only elements that satisfy a condition.

patterns.name: Transform
patterns.description: Produce a new collection by changing every element.

patterns.name: Search
patterns.description: Find the position or existence of a target; linear or binary.

patterns.name: Nested loop
patterns.description: Loop inside a loop: grids, pairs, comparisons.

patterns.name: Early return
patterns.description: Exit as soon as an answer is known; break and return inside loops.

patterns.name: Boundary
patterns.description: Empty input, single element, off-by-one, first and last, zero and negative.

patterns.name: Guard
patterns.description: Validate input and reject bad cases before the main logic.

patterns.name: State machine
patterns.description: Behaviour depends on a mode that changes as input is processed.

patterns.name: Index math
patterns.description: Compute positions: modulo, midpoints, reversed indices, two pointers.

patterns.name: Recursion
patterns.description: A function that calls itself with a smaller problem.

patterns.name: String parse
patterns.description: Split, slice, scan and rebuild text.

patterns.name: Dictionary lookup
patterns.description: Count, group or map with a dictionary.

patterns.name: Set operations
patterns.description: Union, intersection, difference, dedupe.

patterns.name: Aliasing
patterns.description: Copy vs reference; side effects through shared objects.

patterns.name: Sort with key
patterns.description: Order records by a chosen field using a helper.

patterns.name: Aggregate
patterns.description: Summarise records: min, max, mean, group totals.

patterns.name: Composition
patterns.description: Small functions or classes combined into a larger behaviour.

patterns.name: Spec to steps
patterns.description: Turn a plain-language requirement into ordered steps or pseudocode before coding.

patterns.name: Trace
patterns.description: Follow variables by hand through a given program.

patterns.name: Predict output
patterns.description: State what a snippet prints without running it.

patterns.name: Spot the bug
patterns.description: Find the one line that breaks the program.

patterns.name: Refactor to class
patterns.description: Turn procedural code into a class with methods.

patterns.name: Inheritance dispatch
patterns.description: Base and derived classes, overriding, polymorphic calls.

patterns.name: Interface contract
patterns.description: Program to an interface; multiple implementations.

patterns.name: Refactor to pattern
patterns.description: Apply a named design pattern to remove duplication or coupling.

patterns.name: Schema design
patterns.description: Design tables, documents or classes with correct keys and relationships.

patterns.name: SQL DDL
patterns.description: CREATE, ALTER, constraints.

patterns.name: SQL DML
patterns.description: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE.

patterns.name: SQL select
patterns.description: SELECT with WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT.

patterns.name: SQL join
patterns.description: Inner, left and multi-table joins.

patterns.name: SQL aggregate
patterns.description: GROUP BY, HAVING, aggregate functions.

patterns.name: SQL subquery
patterns.description: Nested and correlated subqueries.

patterns.name: Mongo find
patterns.description: Query documents with operators and projections.

patterns.name: Mongo update
patterns.description: Update operators, upserts, array updates.

patterns.name: Mongo aggregate
patterns.description: Aggregation pipelines: match, group, sort, project.

patterns.name: DOM event
patterns.description: Attach handlers, read inputs, update the page.

patterns.name: CSS layout
patterns.description: Flexbox and grid to hit a target layout.

patterns.name: Responsive rule
patterns.description: Media queries and fluid units to adapt to screen size.

patterns.name: Data pipeline
patterns.description: Chain pandas or numpy operations to reach a result.

patterns.name: Plot spec
patterns.description: Choose and configure the right chart for a question.

patterns.name: Model fit and eval
patterns.description: Split, fit, predict, score with the right metric.
